raw_answer_text:
```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

class backup "Diverse-path backup WAN link" style=dashed

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Regional Hub Router (Primary)"
node hubbackup "Regional Hub Router (Backup)"

access1 -- branch
access2 -- branch
branch -[primary WAN]-- hubprimary
branch -[backup WAN]-- hubbackup class=backup
```

I fixed the four edge lines: FigDown's topology genre doesn't use an `edge` keyword — links are written directly as `nodeA <op> nodeB`, with a mid-label spelled `-[label]--` (or `->`, `<-`, `<->`) rather than as a trailing quoted argument. The `class=backup` modifier now attaches directly to the operator line for the backup link.
